catholic-encyclopedia-1913-arnold-ipolyi: This 1913 reference article on Arnold Ipolyi — the Hungarian bishop and historian. Antal Aldásy honors his learned works. His collections enriched the national museum. The see of Nagyvárad knew his zeal. A prelate among antiquaries. His art treasures grace the Esztergom museum.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-august-roskov: A 1913 entry on August Roskoványi — the Bishop of Nyitra and canonist. Antal Aldásy honors his learned tomes. His Monumenta mapped Hungarian church law. The see knew his long rule. A prelate among the canonists. His canons guide the Hungarian church.
